plugins.name: danger-guard
plugins.description: Before the agent runs a Bash command, blocks the ones that can wreck the machine or the user's data beyond the working repository: sudo, deletes of broad places and precious files, disk erasure, shutdown, and process kills that would also stop the user's applications

plugins.name: human-edit
plugins.description: human_edit tool: the agent asks the user to edit a file in a tmux split pane and waits until the editor exits

plugins.name: jj
plugins.description: Adds the jj counts (changed files, unpushed commits) and commit and log buttons to the line under the prompt, with a pane for the jj log

plugins.name: next-step
plugins.description: After a turn, shows up to four prompts the user is likely to type next as cards above the prompt: Claude Code's own prompt suggestion first, then more from a fork of the conversation; clicking a card sends it

plugins.name: questions
plugins.description: A list of the decisions the agent made provisionally so work could continue, kept with add_question and shown in a pane for the user to settle by clicking; a question can be talked over with a read-only fork of the conversation first. Adds a pending button to the line under the prompt

plugins.name: pr
plugins.description: A list of the pull requests this session created or edited, with CI and review state, shown in a pane; watches CI after a push, tells the agent about merges and CI failures, and adds the PR numbers and a pr button to the line under the prompt

plugins.name: publish-guard
plugins.description: Before the agent pushes from a repository that has scripts/check-public.sh, runs that check and blocks the push when it finds names or keys that must not be published

plugins.name: quiet-prompts
plugins.description: Draws a prompt that another plugin submitted on its own (a reminder, a notice) as one line in the transcript, without the engine's framing; ctrl+o still shows it in full

plugins.name: refs
plugins.description: A list of the documents and URLs this session relied on, kept by the agent with add_reference and shown in a pane; adds a refs button to the line under the prompt

plugins.name: rich
plugins.description: show tool: the agent draws cards, a box-and-arrow diagram, tables and clickable questions inline in the transcript or in a pane

plugins.name: status-band
plugins.description: A line under the prompt that replaces the status line: model, context use and directory. Other mods add their own buttons to its right

plugins.name: devrep
plugins.description: update_devrep tool: while turned on for a session, the agent keeps a short report of where the work stands (doing now, next, and free sections) in a pane, so the user can pick the session back up without reading the transcript

plugins.name: retro
plugins.description: Looks back on the session in the background and counts what is worth keeping across sessions: a fork of the conversation lists the findings, and only a finding seen twice (or a severe one) is written into the docs by a subagent without the conversation, following the re skill; findings a hook or script could prevent are kept as candidates (/retro candidates). Runs before a compact, after commits and PRs, and after long stretches with corrections; /retro runs it now

plugins.name: verify-guide
plugins.description: When the agent launches an app (portless, playwright-cli open, a dev server), tells it once per repository whether the repository has a run guide (.claude/skills/verify, verifier-*, run-*) to follow, or that it should write one after verifying

plugins.name: dotclaude-ledger
plugins.description: Records every Edit and Write that lands in the dotclaude working copy (file, an excerpt, and the request it answered) outside the repository, so one dotclaude session can split and commit changes many sessions wrote; adds a dotclaude N count to the line under the prompt

plugins.name: write-guard
plugins.description: When the agent's Write lands outside the working directory and creates a new folder to do so, tells the agent in the tool result to check the path for a copying mistake

plugins.name: check-streak
plugins.description: Counts how many times in a row the same check (tests, type check, lint) fails for the agent; on the third failure without a pass, tells the agent in the tool result to stop fixing and call the user with its diagnosis
